name: jevgrep
description: Ask a question about a repository and get the relevant files and source excerpts. Uses your own Jev provider key.

provider.description: The Jev provider that receives source and bills your key.

maxRequests.description: Most provider requests one search can make.

maxUploadMiB.description: Most request data, in MiB, one search can send to the provider.

timeLimitSeconds.description: Longest time one search can run before it stops and returns partial results.

apiKey.description: API key for the chosen Jev provider. Farero stores it encrypted and gives it only to this plugin's search command.

search.description: Ask how, why or where something works in the repository. Returns ranked files, locations and verbatim source excerpts. Sends eligible source to your provider and uses your key.

question.description: A natural-language question about behavior, for example where a request is authorized.

path.description: Folder to search, relative to the worktree root.

exclude.description: One root-relative gitignore pattern to skip, for example src/generated/. Empty means none.

maxSourceBytes.description: Most source excerpt bytes in the printed result. This limits the output only, not the data sent to the provider.

files.description: Count the files and bytes a search may read under a folder. Makes no provider request and needs no key.

path.description: Folder to count, relative to the worktree root.

exclude.description: One root-relative gitignore pattern to skip. Use the same pattern for the search. Empty means none.

list.description: Also list every eligible relative path.

explore.title: Explorer
explore.description: Read-only code research that starts with a Jevgrep search. Use for how, why or where behavior works across a repository. Reports files, locations and evidence.
